## Names

<a id="demo_input_stream"></a>
### [`demo_input_stream`](../../../src/demo_input.asm#L12) `$F300-$F538`

*data*

Attract demo input, one byte per update_actors call (one main loop pass), read through demo_input_ptr while game_mode = 0. Bits 0-3 go to actor_joy_dir (Bruce's joystick direction bits, 0 = pressed: bit 0 up, 1 down, 2 left, 3 right), bits 4-7 go to actor_fire (Bruce's fire flag, 0 = pressed). There is no end marker: the demo ends when Bruce loses his first fall (lose_fall goes to show_title_screen in the demo); in runs this happened after 569 bytes ($F300-$F538), demo_input_ptr = $F539 at lose_fall. The DC release does not hold these bytes (its packed file ends at $F200): its attract demo reads empty RAM, Bruce gets no input and the demo ends at his first lost fall.
